# feega CLI

CLI for feega — an infinite canvas of typed nodes (text, image, video, doc, iframe, social
feed, social post mockup, products, ads) — from the terminal. Brand-scoped; MCP is the
org-scoped, richer surface for agents (see docs/mcp.md and skills/feega/references/tools.md).

## Installation

```bash
curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andreabuttarelli/feega/main/cli/scripts/install.sh | bash
```

## Commands

### Overview
- `feega brands` — List all brands
- `feega health` — Check Supabase / Gemini API status

### Products
- `feega products <slug> [list|sync]` — List catalog, or re-import from the connected store (Shopify/Woo)

### Account & billing
- `feega upgrade <slug> [--credits N | --top-up N]` — Open Stripe checkout for a monthly plan (8–256 credits, 1 credit = €1) or a one-time top-up

### System
- `feega login [--email --password | --password-stdin]` — Authenticate
- `feega logout` — Clear the local session
- `feega update` — Update CLI to latest version
- `feega --help` — Show help

## Environment

- `PUBLIC_APP_URL` — Backend URL (default: http://localhost:5173, falls back to https://feega.app)

## Auth

Run `feega login` once to authenticate via browser, or non-interactively with `feega login --email you@example.com --password …` (or `--password-stdin` to keep the password out of shell history and `ps`). Session is saved in `~/.config/feega/session.json`.

## MCP

MCP server in `mcp/` — stdio + Streamable HTTP. Same OAuth identity as the CLI (no static API tokens).
Org-scoped tools include `query`, `insert_row`, `update_row`, `delete_row`, `describe_node_types`,
`run_node_generation`, `get_media` (signed
`preview_url` to look at an image, `full_url` for the user).

```bash
bun run mcp          # stdio
bun run mcp:http     # http://localhost:8787/mcp
```

Remote (Vercel / `mcp.feega.app`): `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. Full map: `docs/mcp.md`,
`skills/feega/references/tools.md`.

## Observability (Sentry + Supabase)

MCP HTTP logs/errors → Vercel stderr, optional Sentry (`SENTRY_DSN`), optional Supabase `mcp_logs` (`SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`). See `docs/mcp.md`.

## Architecture

The CLI is a thin HTTP client. All operations go through `/api/v1/*` endpoints. No direct database access. No secrets embedded.

```
CLI  → HTTP → /api/v1/brands/:slug/*  → Supabase → Database
MCP  → HTTP → /api/v1/org/*           → Supabase → Database
```
